function.name: open_app
function.description: Open a Fredo desktop app/application by the name the user said. Use ONLY for an explicit open request.

function.name: close_app
function.description: Close an open Fredo desktop app/application by the name the user said. Use ONLY for an explicit close request.

function.name: doom_mode
function.description: Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks Fredo to enter or leave Doom Mode.

surfaces.description: Create or edit a wireframe in the Fredo Wireframe app. Call this whenever the user asks to create, draft, sketch, mock up or visualize an app/screen/page/dashboard — including "let's create a new wireframe for <app>" or "I would like a way to visualize <thing>": use action=wireframe.companion.draftApp with app_name set to the app the user named, then the page is drafted for you. Use ONLY for Wireframe requests.

commands.label: Draft app
commands.description: Draft a deterministic starter wireframe for a named app: a navbar, a heading with the app name, and a report card

args.name: app_name
args.description: The app name the user named; used for the heading and the report card label

args.name: summary
args.description: Optional context; the deterministic draft does not use it

offer.name: wireframe
offer.description: Create or edit a wireframe in the Fredo Wireframe app. Call this whenever the user asks to create, draft, sketch, mock up or visualize an app/screen/page/dashboard — including "let's create a new wireframe for <app>" or "I would like a way to visualize <thing>": use action=wireframe.companion.draftApp with app_name set to the app the user named, then the page is drafted for you. Use ONLY for Wireframe requests. Actions: wireframe.add.text, wireframe.add.button, wireframe.add.input, wireframe.add.image, wireframe.add.icon, wireframe.add.card, wireframe.add.section, wireframe.add.shape, wireframe.add.line, wireframe.element.duplicate, wireframe.element.delete, wireframe.element.toggleLock, wireframe.edit.undo, wireframe.edit.redo, wireframe.zoom.in, wireframe.zoom.out, wireframe.view.fitPage, wireframe.view.resetView, wireframe.view.togglePan, wireframe.file.saveAs, wireframe.file.open, wireframe.file.exportPng, wireframe.arrange.group, wireframe.arrange.ungroup, wireframe.arrange.toggleGroupLock, wireframe.arrange.toggleSnap, wireframe.arrange.alignLeft, wireframe.arrange.alignCenter, wireframe.arrange.alignRight, wireframe.arrange.distribute, wireframe.arrange.bringForward, wireframe.arrange.sendBackward, wireframe.document.new, wireframe.mode.select, wireframe.mode.draw.rect, wireframe.mode.draw.ellipse, wireframe.element.create, wireframe.element.editFill, wireframe.companion.draftApp, listActions.
